notes: This page has no building step. It shows how to sort the loose pieces: put them on a table, not on grass, and sort them by colour. No pieces or connections are added.
Unrelated to the build: the claude.ai Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors need authorization in your claude.ai connector settings. They can't be used until then.

The page shows how to assemble the minifigures: Gollum in 3 steps, plus Frodo and Sam. Minifigure parts (heads, torsos, legs, hair, capes) are not in the parts list, so they are not recorded as pieces.

The only listed piece clearly placed is the silver fish (lego-64648), which Gollum holds in step 3. It clutches nothing below it, so rests_on is empty. I did not record a join to Gollum's hand because Gollum is not a node.
Frodo and Sam each hold a sword and a small item. I could not tell which sword is lego-10053 and which is lego-95673, so I left both unplaced. They are probably placed on a later page.
Unrelated to the build: the claude.ai Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors still need authorization in your claude.ai connector settings. They can't be used until then.
Step 1: the 75° slope (b3) goes on the left end of the 2x10 plate (b2).

Step 2: a flat 1x2 piece and two cheese slopes are added next to the tall slope. I read the flat piece as a Dark Bluish Gray grooved tile (lego-3069b) and the slopes as Dark Bluish Gray lego-54200. The picture is small, so exact positions are approximate. All three are assumed to sit directly on the 2x10 plate.
The top-left inset shows the finished sub-model this page builds. It adds no pieces.
Unrelated to the build: the claude.ai Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors still need authorization in your claude.ai connector settings. They can't be used until then.
Step 3: the 1x1 Technic brick (b7) goes on the base plate to the right of the slopes. The light grey Technic pin (b8) is pushed into its side hole.

Step 4 has three parts. The dark grey sloped piece looks like a 45° 2x1 slope; I read it as lego-3040b (b9) and placed it on the earlier cheese slope b5. That placement is uncertain. The second 75° tall slope (b10) is placed on the base plate. The small clip plate (b11) is read as lego-4085c.
The clip plate (b11) sits on the left side of the model. I assumed it attaches sideways to b9, and its rests_on is empty. This is an assumption from a small image.
Unrelated to the build: the claude.ai Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors still need authorization in your claude.ai connector settings. They can't be used until then.

Sub-assembly 5 is a small cart. Sub-steps 1-2: the panel (b13) and the grooved tile (b14) go on the 2x4 plate (b12). Sub-steps 3-4: the plate is turned over. Two side-handle plates (b15, b16) and the black 2x2 pin-hole plate (b17) are added underneath.
I read the 2x dark pieces as lego-2540 (Dark Bluish Gray, 2 in the parts list). I read the black piece as lego-2817.
The three underside parts clip onto the plate's anti-studs from below. I recorded them with rests_on = b12 even though they hang beneath it. The contact is the same.
The red arrow shows the finished cart going onto the pin b8 of the main model. I assumed the pin enters a pin hole of b17.
Unrelated to the build: the claude.ai Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors still need authorization in your claude.ai connector settings. They can't be used until then.

Step 6 adds a 45° 2x1 slope and a tall 75° slope at the right end of the model, beside the cart. I read these as lego-3040b and lego-4460b, both Dark Bluish Gray. I could not tell exactly which part they sit on, so I assumed the base plate b2. This is uncertain.
Step 7 adds two small cheese slopes (lego-54200, Dark Bluish Gray, 2x). I assumed they sit on the studs of the cart's panel b13. This is uncertain.
Unrelated to the build: the claude.ai Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors still need authorization in your claude.ai connector settings. They can't be used until then.

Step 8 builds a small bridge piece in three sub-steps and sets it on top of the two tall slopes, closing the arch. The bridge is a 1x4 plate (b22) with two cheese slopes, a grooved tile and a clip plate.
I assumed the 1x4 plate sits on the single top studs of the two tall slopes b3 and b10 and spans the gap between them. The picture is small, so this is uncertain.
The clip plate (b26) is attached at the right end of the bridge, with its clip sticking out. I recorded it as resting on b22 and added no clip join, because nothing in the picture is clipped into it.
Unrelated to the build: the claude.ai Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors still need authorization in your claude.ai connector settings. They can't be used until then.

Step 9 adds two cheese slopes. The red arrow shows one going onto the single top stud of the left tall slope (b3). I put the second on the top stud of the right tall slope b19. The page shows only one placement, so this is an assumption.

Step 10 adds two spiky dark green vines (lego-55236, 2x), draped across the arch. Nothing in the picture clearly fixes them, so I assumed they are held by the two clip plates (b26 and b11). The exact attachment is uncertain.
Step 9's arrow stud conflicts slightly with my earlier assumption that bridge b22 sits on the top studs of b3 and b10. The earlier placement was a guess from a small image.

Step 13 is a spider leg built 8 times (the 8x box). The parts box lists the parts for all 8 legs. This page shows only sub-steps 1-3 of one leg: a Reddish Brown 1x4 plate, then two black one-finger hinge plates (lego-44301a) on it, one at each end with fingers out. Each leg's pieces are listed as b65-b67, b68-b70, b71-b73, b74-b76, b77-b79, b80-b82, b83-b85 and b86-b88. The remaining leg parts (cylinder, slope, tile, three RB hinge plates, claw) come on later pages.
In the sub-step 3 picture a brown piece shows between the hinge plates. I could not identify it and did not place it. It may belong to a later sub-step.

Parts count: the legs need 16 black lego-44301a, which is all of them. So the black plates I recorded earlier on the body (b33-b36, b40, b41, b43, b44 on pages 11-13) were probably lego-73983 swivel plates instead. I could not correct earlier pages, so those entries may carry the wrong type.

This page continues the 8x spider leg. Each leg gets five more pieces. Leg 1 is b89-b93, leg 2 is b94-b98, leg 3 is b99-b103, leg 4 is b104-b108, leg 5 is b109-b113, leg 6 is b114-b118, leg 7 is b119-b123 and leg 8 is b124-b128. Each leg's five pieces in order are: the RB grooved tile, the RB two-finger hinge plate, the RB cheese slope, the black hinge cylinder and the black claw.
The grooved tile is the brown piece visible in the middle of the leg in page 17's sub-step 3. I missed it on that page. I add it here as sitting on the leg's 1x4 plate.

Step 4: a Reddish Brown two-finger hinge plate hinges onto the left black hinge plate. Step 5: a Reddish Brown cheese slope goes on that hinge plate. Step 6: a black hinge cylinder hinges onto the right black hinge plate. Step 7: the black claw (lego-87747) goes into the cylinder's axle hole.
Each leg shows only one lego-44302a here. The parts box lists 24 of them (3 per leg). The other two per leg are presumably added on later pages.
Unrelated to the build: the claude.ai Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors still need authorization in your claude.ai connector settings. They can't be used until then.

I assumed the unit's hinge plate b135 clutches the tan plate b62 on the body. The picture shows no hinge base on the body, so I recorded no hinge join.
